Engineering Graduate School Funding
Partial tuition scholarships may be available to qualified master’s degree applicants. Ph.D. candidates are awarded full financial aid in the form of teaching or research assistantships. Both assistantships typically include a full-tuition scholarship, monthly stipend, and paid health insurance. Student activity fees, which allow access to the student recreation center, are also covered. In addition, individual fellowship awards above and beyond the standard financial aid package are regularly awarded to outstanding applicants.
Apply Now
On this page
School of Engineering Ph.D. Funding Support
TA and RA annual stipend award starting at $40,000 (Fall 2026)
Full tuition award
Paid health insurance
Relocation allowance
Paid activity and recreation fees
Additional fellowships ranging from $1,000 - $10,000 per year are available for highly qualified applicants.
Engineering Graduate Teaching Assistantships
Financial support provided by department
Main responsibility is to assist instructors
Continuing support is contingent upon academic progress and positive evaluation
Teaching assistantships are short-term support and priority is given to new incoming graduate students
Engineering Graduate Research Assistantships
Financial support provided by individual faculty members through research grants
Main responsibility is to assist faculty members with research project(s)
Continuing support is contingent upon academic and research progress as well as availability of funds
